name: Santa Monica College
description:
Santa Monica College is a public community college founded in its namesake city in 1929. The college offers over 180 degrees and certificate programs in animation, business, and web development. Academic excellence is a cornerstone of the collegeâ€™s reputation, as the courses are taught by award-winning artists, scholars, and scientists.

Significantly, the college has the highest number of transfers to University of California campuses than any other college in the country. International students are attracted to the opportunities awarded at Santa Monica College, with around 3,300 international students from over 100 countries enrolled in courses each year.

At Santa Monica College, students experience a stimulating environment with top-notch facilities. The performing arts centre is a stage for creativity, hosting captivating concerts, theatre productions, and dance performances that entertain audiences.

Student Life

Students can experience a bustling atmosphere throughout the year thanks to the regular events. Fuel for finals week offers students free breakfast, snacks and lunch on all campuses to ensure they are prepared to concentrate on achieving their best. Homecoming week gives students a chance to reconnect with each other and watch live football, while Midterm Motivation provides students with mental health breaks and opportunities to unwind. Students organise their fun on campus, too, with over 50 student clubs registered with the student union.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Santa Monica College is a public community college founded in its namesake city in 1929. The college offers over 180 degrees and certificate programs in animation, business, and web development. Academic excellence is a cornerstone of the college's reputation, as the courses are taught by award-winning artists, scholars, and scientists.

Significantly, the college has the highest number of transfers to University of California campuses than any other college in the country. International students are attracted to the opportunities awarded at Santa Monica College, with around 3,300 international students from over 100 countries enrolled in courses each year.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: A range of housing options are available to students at Santa Monica College. The college provides fully furnished residence halls that ensure a comfortable and convenient living experience. The Main Street Residence Hall offers apartments with amenities such as a fully equipped kitchen, private bedrooms, and shared common areas. Another option is the 17th Street Residence Hall, which provides furnished units with a modern and vibrant living environment. These residence halls are located near the college campus, making it convenient for students to travel to their classes.

highlights.title: Lab
highlights.value: The college boasts state-of-the-art classrooms, and the campus is peppered with fully-equipped science and computer labs that let students unleash the power of experimentation and innovation.

highlights.title: Library
highlights.value: The library offers a vast collection of books, digital resources, and cosy study nooks for students to enjoy.

highlights.title: Cafeteria
highlights.value: Multiple trendy cafes and eateries are dotted throughout the campus to offer an array of culinary treats to please all palettes.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value: For fitness enthusiasts, the sizable gymnasium, sports fields, and fitness centre offer the latest equipment.
